scope: Recorded on this machine; historical observations, not live usage.

models.label: High RAM · avoid when memory is tight
models.summary: FLM reached 32.8 GiB RAM, with repeated 32+ GiB peaks and some swapping. Avoid for everyday use when other apps need memory; choose a smaller model.

evidence.excerpt: Only Qwen3.8-27B-NPU2 was loaded in this service session. Consumed 1min 9.283s CPU time over 1min 52.653s wall clock time, 32.8G memory peak, 238.6M memory swap peak.
Qwen3.8-27B-NPU2 session: 32.7G memory peak, 43.6M memory swap peak. Another session at 10:36:08 peaked at 32.5G.

models.label: High RAM
models.summary: A Gemma4 E4B IT session peaked at 19.7 GiB RAM. Prefer a smaller model when memory is tight; leave room for other applications.

evidence.excerpt: Session loaded Gemma4-E4B-IT-NPU2. Consumed 4min 53.030s CPU time over 25min 40.351s wall clock time, 19.7G memory peak.

models.label: CPU fallback · GPU load failures
models.summary: GPU loading repeatedly failed on this machine. The local configuration uses CPU inference with 12 threads instead. Avoid when low CPU usage is a priority. A per-model peak RAM measurement was not recorded.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-GGUF repeatedly failed Vulkan loading with vk::Queue::submit: ErrorDeviceLost between 16:17 and 16:21.
Using LlamaCpp Backend: cpu. llama threadpool init, n_threads = 12. Model loaded at n_ctx_slot = 65536.

models.label: GPU memory failures · avoid full offload
models.summary: Repeated GPU memory failures were logged with full offload and four 32K-context slots. Avoid that setup on this machine; reduce GPU offload, context, or concurrent slots before trying it again.

evidence.excerpt: Loading model: qwopus3.6-35b-a3b-coder-mtp. n_gpu_layers = 999999; n_slots = 4, n_ctx_slot = 32768. radv/amdgpu: Not enough memory for command submission. ggml_vulkan: device lost on Vulkan0. Repeated through 09:47:45.
The same Qwopus model also logged Not enough memory for command submission followed by ErrorDeviceLost in repeated loading attempts.

models.label: High CPU · RAM and swap usage
models.summary: The recorded CPU-server run averaged about 7.7 CPU cores, peaked at 7.2 GiB RAM and used up to 1.3 GiB swap. This includes startup and compilation. Avoid for low-resource background use on this machine.

evidence.excerpt: Service logs identify Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B with device_config=cpu. Consumed 47min 48.446s CPU time over 6min 14.140s wall clock time, 7.2G memory peak, 1.3G memory swap peak. CPU seconds / wall seconds = 7.67 average busy cores.

models.label: High CPU
models.summary: The recorded server run averaged about 5.6 CPU cores and peaked at 1.6 GiB RAM. Avoid for low-CPU background use. These are whole-service averages, including startup, rather than an instantaneous CPU reading.

evidence.excerpt: Service loaded Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf with threads=12. Consumed 23min 43.529s CPU time over 4min 15.945s wall clock time, 1.6G memory peak. CPU seconds / wall seconds = 5.56 average busy cores.

models.label: System hang · hard reset required
models.summary: Loading this model wedged the GPU driver and hung the whole machine: its llama-server never became healthy and spun in the kernel's amdgpu memory allocator for over 2.5 hours (346 soft-lockup reports) until a hard reset at 01:36. Unload every other GPU model first, do not queue it behind other big Vulkan loads, and expect to reset the machine if it fails to come up.

evidence.excerpt: After julianmb-Qwen-3.8-27B-ROCmFP4-FAST-GGUF failed: 'Loading model: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-GGUF' followed by 'Process started successfully, PID: 1897691'.

watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#23 stuck for 26s! [llama-server:1897691] — 346 such reports, the last at 2026-10-18 01:36:30 reading 'stuck for 9022s', all inside amdgpu/TTM GPU-memory allocation. A parallel amdgpu gfxhub page-fault storm began at 22:50:03.

The boot's journal ends mid-lockup at 01:36:35 with no shutdown sequence and the next boot starts 01:40:43 (hard reset). The daemon had logged 'llama-server failed to start within timeout' at 23:03:57 — the model never served a single token.

models.label: Load failure · GPU driver stall
models.summary: The load ran 8.5 minutes without coming up; the process stopped responding and the daemon sat on 'waiting for GPU driver cleanup' before killing it. It failed immediately before the Oct 17 GPU lockup hang. Avoid queueing it behind other big Vulkan loads — restart Lemonade between attempts.

evidence.excerpt: 22:53:50 'Process terminated, waiting for GPU driver cleanup...'; 22:53:52 'Backend load failed: llama-server failed to start' and 'Load failed with non-file-not-found error, evicting all models and retrying'. The next load (Ornith-1.5-35B) then wedged the driver at 22:55:30.

models.label: Load failure · SIGKILL on start
models.summary: llama-server failed to start within seconds of launch and did not respond to SIGTERM, so it was SIGKILLed. This was the first failure in the Oct 17 sequence that ended in the GPU lockup hang; after a failure like this, stop and restart the backend instead of letting the harness retry the next big model.

evidence.excerpt: 22:40:22 'llama-server failed to start within timeout'; 22:40:27 'Process did not respond to SIGTERM, using SIGKILL'.

models.label: Hard reset while serving · heavy prompt cache
models.summary: The machine went down with no panic, OOM, or lockup logged at 13:05:37 while this model was actively generating (journal and LM Studio logs stop mid-request; next boot banner 44 seconds later). Its server was also evicting multi-GiB prompt-cache entries, the largest 5174 MiB. The cause was not captured, so this is correlation rather than proof — keep RAM headroom and supervise long unattended runs.

evidence.excerpt: srv alloc: - making room for prompt cache entry, removing oldest entry (size = 5174.300 MiB), logged while launching a chat task; another entry of 2527.775 MiB was evicted at 12:42:14. The model was loaded at 11:56:04 with loaded_context_length = 32768.

evidence.source: System journal, /var/log/kern.log, LM Studio log · boot boundary
evidence.excerpt: Last journal entry 13:05:30 (GET /api/system-stats 200), last kernel line 13:05:37, next kernel line is the 13:06:21 boot banner — no shutdown sequence and no error logged. LM Studio's last entries are 13:05:11 '[qwen3.8-27b-ssmfix-ud] Start to generate a tool call... / Tool name generated: question'.
